meta.title: DOSM construction statistics, Q2 2026 (value of work done)
meta.licence: Malaysian Government Open Data Terms of Use 1.0: reuse including commercial use is permitted with attribution to the Department of Statistics Malaysia.
caveats: Value of work done (nominal, main contractors) is a different measure from the real GDP construction series in dosm-gdp-construction-quarterly.json; growth rates differ (8.8 vs 6.5 percent for Q2 2026).
Shares are as published and may not sum to exactly 100 because of rounding.
